rows.q: When do I escalate to the shift manager?
rows.answer: Escalate to the shift manager when a Gold job is in SLA breach, when 3 or more jobs in one city are delayed at the same time, or when a job is more than 4 hours late. [SOP-LD §7]

rows.q: What credit does a Silver customer get for an SLA breach?
rows.answer: SLA breach: Gold 25% of the job fee, Silver 15%, Bronze 10%. Cancellation by NorthStar with under 24 hours notice: 20%. Repeat visit due to our error: the repeat visit is free. Full refunds require a manager. [SOP-RF §3] A customer is eligible for a credit when a job is in SLA breach, when a job is cancelled by NorthStar with less than 24 hours notice, or when a repeat visit is needed because of our error. [SOP-RF §2]

rows.q: Can a dispatcher approve a full refund?
rows.answer: Dispatchers may offer credits up to 25% of the job fee. Credits above 25% and all full refunds need shift manager approval. Technicians may not promise credits or refunds to customers. [SOP-RF §4] Sets when customers receive a service credit or refund for late or failed jobs, and who may approve it. [SOP-RF §1]

rows.q: How long does a refund to a card take?
rows.answer: Credits are applied to the customer's next invoice. Refunds to card are processed by Finance within 5 business days. [SOP-RF §6]

rows.q: Who is allowed to reassign a job?
rows.answer: Only dispatchers and managers may reassign jobs. Technicians may request a reassignment by creating a ticket on their job but may not move jobs themselves. [SOP-RA §4] Do not reassign a job more than twice. A third change requires the shift manager. [SOP-RA §7]

rows.q: How do I choose which technician gets a reassigned job?
rows.answer: Notify both technicians, keep the original job ID, and send the customer an update with the new technician's first name and ETA following SOP-CU. [SOP-RA §6] Reassign when the assigned technician cannot reach the job before its SLA deadline (vehicle breakdown, parts missing, sick or off shift), or when a free technician in the same city can arrive at least 30 minutes sooner. [SOP-RA §2]

rows.q: Can a job be reassigned three times?
rows.answer: Do not reassign a job more than twice. A third change requires the shift manager. [SOP-RA §7]

rows.q: What does the pre-trip vehicle check include?
rows.answer: Before the first job each day the technician checks tires, lights, brakes, mirrors and the load strap, and records the check in the driver app. A failed check means the vehicle may not leave the depot. [SOP-SC §2]

rows.q: What should a technician do if the site is unsafe?
rows.answer: On arrival the technician confirms safe parking, a clear walkway, and no visible hazards such as exposed wiring or standing water. If the site is unsafe the technician must not start work and must create a ticket. [SOP-SC §3]

rows.q: What must every customer update include?
rows.answer: Every update includes the job ID, an apology if we are late, the reason in plain words, the new ETA as a time window, and the first name of the technician. Do not share the technician's phone number or blame the technician. [SOP-CU §3]

rows.q: What's the overtime pay rate for technicians?
rows.why: answered instead of I don't know: 'Notify both technicians, keep the original job ID, and send the customer an update with the new tech'
rows.answer: Notify both technicians, keep the original job ID, and send the customer an update with the new technician's first name and ETA following SOP-CU. [SOP-RA §6] Pick a technician whose home city matches the job's city and who has no open jobs (no job that is Scheduled, En Route or In Progress) for the day. Prefer the matching skill: Installer for installs, Repair Tech for repairs, any role for deliveries and pickups. [SOP-RA §3]
